properties.displayName: MAS - Manual attestation for Incident Response Playbooks for DDOS
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure the organization have DDoS monitoring controls in place. (Monitoring-IR-152).

metadata.Description:
Incident Response Playbooks
Post-Incident Analysis

for more details - refer to Control statement
Incident Response Playbooks
- Develop predefined playbooks for various DDoS scenarios:
- For volumetric attacks, redirect traffic through scrubbing centers using F5 or Akamai
- For application-layer attacks, deploy rate-limiting policies via API gateways or web application firewalls (WAFs).
- For hybrid environments, use BGP routing to reroute traffic to unaffected regions or providers
Post-Incident Analysis
- Perform packet captures (PCAPs) of attack traffic for forensic analysis.
- Generate post-incident reports detailing attack vectors, mitigation actions, and service impact
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure the organization have DDoS monitoring controls in place.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
